name: Tensei Yuusha to Ryousai Maou no Kozukuri Slow Life
original_name: 転生勇者と良妻魔王の子作りスローライフ
source:
You save the beautiful demon lord from an evil spirit that had been controlling her and run away together to start a new life.
Enjoy a flirty loving baby making life full of love and sex!

After saving Rishie, you discover that she is much kinder and gentler than a demon.
Enjoy sweet time spent with your new beautiful wife!
